content: Despite showing positive results in tasks such as language modeling and classification BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 , the BOW representation has limitations: first, feature vectors are commonly very high-dimensional, resulting in sparse document representations, which are hard to model due to space and time complexity. Second, BOW does not consider the proximity of words and their position in the text and consequently cannot encode the words semantic meanings.
